name: operations.decisions.history
summary: Native decision report history bound to current report lineage.
purpose: Read the native history array of one current decision report without appending the current row.

list.description: Verify current report context, then read all returned native history versions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Native integer id of the current decision report; distinct from historical version ids.

identity_description: Native integer historical row id; version is preserved independently, and duplicate row ids fail.

fields.name: reportId
fields.meaning: Verified report lineage from current detail.

fields.name: groupId
fields.meaning: Verified report group lineage from current detail.

limitations: POST /api/ai/decision/report/getDetail.json and then /api/ai/decision/report/getHistory.json with exactly tntInstId=GUAPW3SG and the selected integer id. Two independent standard single-response sources share a 300-second deadline and two logical pages, with existing bounded retries.

Current native detail must echo the requested integer id and provide nonblank reportId/groupId/tntInstId. Every historical row must match all three fields and have integer id/version. Duplicate history ids fail; no winner is selected.

Each source is qualified as one entire native response with unknown native total. The host retains separate root/history acquisition evidence and a validated_sources aggregate; no claim is made about backend versions absent from the returned array or atomic consistency between the sequential inquiries.

Return only native historical records in response order, preserving all fields, nested values, numeric precision and nulls. Never append the current detail. An empty history array is valid and remains empty.

Live does not publish. Complete nonempty refresh publishes and offline replays its own saved scope; failed or empty refresh preserves the previous capture. Auth, business, schema, identity and lineage failures abort the entire inquiry.

No public Get, arbitrary report query, latest-version selection, legacy runtime dependency or native value conversion. Workflow preserve import retains independent observations without replacing current data.
